profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server | Multi-tenant SaaS
profile.summary:
I'm a full stack engineer with nearly 5 years of experience, the last 4+ as an early engineer at DealerOps, where our team builds a multi-tenant SaaS platform serving 1,000+ dealership rooftops. I own features from database schema to UI, and I'm usually the one debugging them if something breaks in production.

Some of what I've built there:

- A notification framework in NestJS and BullMQ, with event-driven triggers and in-app and email delivery
- A customizable KPI dashboard (GraphQL + Chart.js), now a headline feature in sales demos
- A Zoho Desk to GitLab sync service, moved from polling to webhooks, routing 10+ tickets a day

Outside work, I co-own a fragrance e-commerce store and built all of its tech: a custom Shopify storefront and a subscription app (Remix, Prisma, PostgreSQL) that lets customers choose which scent ships each month.

Stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Docker

Always happy to talk tech! Feel free to message me here.

projects.title: Custom Shopify Storefront for a Fragrance E-commerce Brand
projects.description:
Sole developer for a fragrance e-commerce store I co-own, turning Shopify's Dawn theme into a fully custom storefront in Liquid and vanilla JavaScript.

- Deals modal: turns tiered mix-and-match discounts into a guided shopping flow, with live tier progress, in-modal browsing and add-to-cart, and prices that match the discount app to the cent. Deep links let ad and email campaigns open straight into a specific deal.

- Discount layer: chose a third-party discount app over custom Shopify Functions (Shopify Plus only), then built a shared tier-state module that drives progress bars across the cart drawer, cart page, nav, and sticky add-to-cart.

- Cart drawer: built on the Cart AJAX API with optimistic updates and rollback, per-line debouncing to prevent out-of-order responses, and line-derived totals that fixed a subtotal mismatch.

- Scent profiles: ~24 custom metafields power product pages (accords, performance, note pyramid), linked to a 25-note library and 37-brand directory.

- Performance: deferred third-party scripts, made stylesheets non-blocking, and lazy-loaded note images, saving ~3MB per product page.

projects.title: Custom Shopify Subscription App
projects.description:
Embedded Shopify subscription app I built from scratch as sole developer. It powers the fragrance storefront's monthly subscription, where customers choose which scent ships each month on 3 to 24-month plans.

- Queue design: the monthly queue lives in the app's own PostgreSQL schema (Prisma), and only the next month's product syncs to the Shopify subscription contract through draft-and-commit edits, keeping Shopify as the billing source of truth.

- Customer portal: served inside the storefront through a Shopify App Proxy. Customers can change or swap months, skip with a 72-hour cutoff, and pause, resume, or cancel their plan.

- Webhooks: 10 Shopify topics with HMAC verification and duplicate-delivery detection.

- Payment failures: locks the queue, emails the customer at most once a day, and shifts remaining months forward after a successful retry.

- Architecture: refactored a monolithic loader into 16 command-pattern actions with Zod validation and sanitized errors, cutting it by 91%, plus per-customer rate limiting.

- Security: fixed a researcher's finding by validating client-supplied variant IDs server-side before checkout.

- Infrastructure: isolated development and production environments on Railway, each with its own Docker service and managed PostgreSQL, plus GitHub Actions CI and scheduled jobs for monthly cycle locking and nightly contract reconciliation.

Stack: Remix, React, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Shopify Admin GraphQL API, Docker, Railway, GitHub Actions
